title: Restore classifier endpoints on moderation API
body:
## Summary
- keep `/check-result` public on `moderation-api.divine.video`
- restore `/api/v1/classifier/:sha256` and `/api/v1/classifier/:sha256/recommendations`
- accept the existing bearer token aliases used across callers
- document the classifier and recommendation endpoints

## Verification
- `npm test -- --run src/index.test.mjs`
- deployed `divine-moderation-api`
- `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer ..." https://moderation-api.divine.video/api/v1/classifier/6d79c27ab63035050a3a4b9aa1b86d75406ebba2112185fc64057d51df07e290/recommendations`

title: fix: use media.divine.video URL format for blossom videos
body: Blossom serves blobs by hash without extension at media.divine.video, not cdn.divine.video/{sha256}.mp4. The old URL format caused Hive AI to get 404s when trying to fetch videos for analysis.
